rows.label: tlk43600142_01_msg0002
rows.name:
We were so close to open war
with Superbia, but it was
averted at the last moment.

rows.label: tlk43600142_01_msg0003
rows.name:
It would have been my big chance
to make a huge profit...

rows.label: tlk43600142_01_msg0004
rows.name:
I lend money to wounded soldiers and
to widows and children. It's a good
opportunity for business.

rows.label: tlk43600142_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Just whose side is Queen Lagert on,
anyway...?
